# explorer-verify

> explorer-verify verifies the source of deployed smart contracts on block explorers: Etherscan (API v2), Blockscout, Sourcify and Routescan, with one API for a browser, a backend or a CLI. It is in design: nothing is published to npm yet, and no explorer client exists. The user docs grow with each feature. The npm package ships these pages under `docs/` with its own `llms.txt`, so an agent working in `node_modules` reads the docs of the installed version.

Submitting a verification is outward and permanent. Read the agent page before you call the library or the CLI on someone's behalf.

## User docs

- [User documentation](https://github.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/blob/main/docs/user/README.md): index of the user pages and the planned ones
- [Using explorer-verify from an agent](https://github.com/aelmanaa/explorer-verify/blob/main/docs/user/guides/using-from-an-agent.md): which calls are safe, which one submits, where keys come from
